result.title: Shared-Factor-Conditioned Diffusion for Low-Rank Tensor Recovery
result.summary: Tensor recovery spans heterogeneous data structures and observation processes, calling for a representation that can adapt across modalities and tasks. We propose DiffTR, an unsupervised framework that unifies tensor completion, denoising, and hyperspectral super-resolution through coordinate-conditioned diffusion. Shared factors indexed by tensor coordinates condition a compact score network, and score matching jointly learns the factors and an implicit tensor representation from the available observations. Scalar and vector-valued outputs accommodate individual entries and entire tubes, enabling a common formulation for tabular tensors, images, and videos. The framework separates representation learning from task-specific observation modeling: reverse diffusion recovers missing values; estimation via Tweedie's formula, soft thresholding, and optional spatial consistency support mixed-noise denoising; and measurement-guided sampling transfers a prior learned from low-resolution hyperspectral observations to high-resolution reconstruction, followed by post-sampling refinement with data consistency and spectral subspace regularization. This separation makes the representation compatible with different corruption models and permits task-specific constraints to be incorporated within the same recovery framework. Experiments across multiple tensor modalities and recovery tasks demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality and the flexibility of a unified conditional generative representation. The code is available at https://github.com/CZY-Code/DiffTR

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DiffTR，用坐标索引的共享因子条件化紧凑 score network，并以 score matching 联合学习该因子与隐式张量表示，无监督统一张量补全、混合噪声去噪与高光谱超分辨。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「表示学习与观测模型分离」加「测量引导反向扩散采样」的设计，可能为 latent 推理中如何把视觉证据注入生成式状态更新提供可供核查的方法线索；但论文任务属低层信号恢复，本身无显式推理过程。
